An interactive creative world editor for Minecraft 1.7.10.

<!-- changelog -->

## Installing

> **Sculptor requires WorldEdit and installs alongside it.** Keep
> `worldedit-*.jar` where it is — Sculptor will not load without it.

Drop the jar in `mods/`. It is a universal Forge mod — the same file goes on the client
and on the server, and both need it for the editor to work in multiplayer.

Requires **worldedit-gtnh**, **GTNHLib** and **ModularUI2**. **Angelica** is optional but
is what the ghost renderer is designed against.

On a server, applying a brush requires permission: op by default, or the `sculptor.brush`
node if a permissions mod is installed.

See the [README](https://github.com/OrderedSet86/gtnh-sculptor#readme) for controls and
known gaps.
